criticism: The transfer function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has sufficient balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The mintToken function does not check if the target address has sufficient balance before minting tokens. This could allow a user to mint more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The freezeAccount function does not check if the target address has sufficient balance before freezing their account. This could allow a user to freeze their account without sufficient balance, potentially leading to loss of funds.
